parameters.content:
## ResearchForge × n8n
Company/Ticker → official filing discovery → verified research.

**Local-only.** Configure trusted backend/public URLs in Prepare request, never in user input.

Wait: 2s; ≤60 polls / 150s. Failure output never invents research. n8n timeout does not cancel backend.

All facts, calculations, evidence and conclusions come from the SAME backend as Web. No LLM, finance formula or verifier lives here.

See integrations/n8n/README.md for import, demo, retries and failures. Failure/ambiguity → explicit abstention; no invented research.
